description: This file defines the FilesApiInterface, an interface specifying methods for file upload, download, deletion, and related operations in the project.

methods.name: startUploadSession(apiToken: string): Promise<HttpResponse<StartUploadSessionResponse>> startUploadSession
methods.description: Starts a new upload session with given API token, returning a promise with the HTTP response containing session info.

methods.name: uploadFileBytes(apiToken: string, chunkId: number, encryptedBytes: Uint8Array): Promise<boolea/ uploadFileBytes
methods.description: Uploads a chunk of file data as encrypted bytes for a specific chunk ID, returns a promise resolving to a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: closeUploadSession(apiToken: string): Promise<boolean> closeUploadSession
methods.description: Closes the current upload session, returning a promise resolving to a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: downloadFile( downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file chunk given certain parameters, invoking a callback with received bytes, returns a promise that resolves to an error or undefined.

methods.name: deleteFile(apiToken: string): Promise<HttpResponse> deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with the provided API token, returning an HTTP response promise.

methods.name: createFileValetToken( createFileValetToken
methods.description: Creates a token for file operations with specified remote identifier and operation type, optionally specifying file size; returns a promise resolving to a token string or an error.

methods.name: getFilesDownloadUrl(): string getFilesDownloadUrl
methods.description: Returns a URL string for file download.

ctags.name: uploadFileBytes
ctags.pattern: /^  uploadFileBytes(apiToken: string, chunkId: number, encryptedBytes: Uint8Array): Promise<boolea/
